objective: Propose an eight-week pilot of later opening hours for a fictional community library. These are synthetic planning records, not claims about a real library.

requirements.description: Choose a bounded pilot schedule supported by the demand evidence.
Explain how the pilot fits available staff hours and state unresolved staffing assumptions.
Define a measurable continuation decision after eight weeks without inventing baseline results.

evidence.text: Synthetic demand record: 42 of 60 survey respondents requested later opening on Tuesday or Thursday. The survey did not measure likely attendance or select between those evenings.

Synthetic staffing record: the library can assign at most eight additional staff-hours per week to a pilot. Two staff members must be present whenever the library is open. Staff consent and exact rosters remain unconfirmed.

Synthetic planning brief: the pilot may run for eight weeks. Track attendance and additional staff-hours each evening, collect visitor feedback, and present a continuation recommendation at the end. No attendance target has been approved.
